paper_title: Small Triangulations of 4-Manifolds and the 4-Manifold Census
classifications: Theory of computation → Random search heuristics
statement: We conjecture that BC supports the standard PL structure because of its small size. Another reason is its relation to a Cappell-Shaneson sphere that is known to be standard [1, 22], see above. 4
context: ▶ Conjecture 8. BC is PL-homeomorphic to the standard 4-ball. 4 We conjecture that BC supports the standard PL structure because of its small size. Another reason is its relation to a Cappell-Shaneson sphere that is known to be standard [1, 22], see above. 4 ▶ Proposition 9. If there exists a sequence of Pachner moves connecting SC to a triangulation of the standard PL 4-sphere, then this sequence must contain at least one triangulation with at least 12 pentachora. 4 Proof. Running an exhaustive enumeration of all local move sequences starting from SC and 4 visiting triangulations up to 10 pentachora (i.e., an excess height of 6) does not connect SC to any other 4-pentachoron triangulation of the 4-sphere. ◀
